blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. will not stop the Senate and the House of Representatives from pursuing efforts to declare Chinese Ambassador to the Philippines Jing Quan persona non grata, Palace press officer Claire Castro said on Wednesday. Two resolutions have been filed in the Senate urging Marcos and the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) to declare Jing persona non grata following his remarks suggesting that China could use force against the Philippines.
